store.summary: ST25R3916 NFC scanner, auto-detect card writer, Crypto1, ML & .nfc studio
store.description: NFC Studio unlocks the ST25R3916 13.56 MHz transceiver on CardputerZero Cap CC1101 & NFC. Scan ISO14443-A/B/F/V tags with fast default-key MIFARE Classic auto-dumps, write saved .nfc files in smart AUTO blank-detection mode onto NTAG213/215/216, Magic Gen1A, Gen2/CUID & standard MIFARE Classic (Pure-Go Crypto1), and NFC-V cards with cross-card compatibility checks, 2-step arming, and read-back verification, compose quick NDEF tags, classify tags and materials with Pure-Go INT8 ML, emulate 4B/7B UIDs, program Waveshare NFC e-Paper badges, and expose 31 tools via opt-in stdio MCP.
